title: Kissed Salty Norwegian Kielbasa Bowl
description: A salty and savory Norwegian dish featuring kielbasa, served in an earthenware bowl. This dish is perfect for a brunch mood.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the sliced Norwegian kielbasa in the air fryer for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the pickled mustard seeds and aquavit jelly.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the cooked kielbasa, pickled mustard seed mixture, frisee, pickled red onion, and salted capers.
Serve the kielbasa mixture in the earthenware bowl, garnished with lemon wedges.
Drizzle any remaining aquavit jelly over the top of the kielbasa mixture.
Consider serving with a side of toasted bread or crackers.
Garnish with additional pickled red onion and salted capers if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
